Welcome to Boone County, Iowa
Boone County was established in 1846. It's home to 11 communities and over 26,000 residents. The County is administered by a three-member Board of Supervisors who are elected for four-year terms. Other elected officials include the Attorney , Auditor , Recorder , Sheriff , and Treasurer .

Mission Statement
The mission of Boone County is to be accountable to its citizens in providing innovative and high-quality
government services in an economical, fair, professional, and courteous manner to enhance and protect the
health, welfare, and safety of those who live and work in Boone County.
